description: TOP10NL Spoorbaandeel (lijnen) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportaaloverijssel.nl. TOP10NL is a digital object-oriented map file that underlies the topographic map 1:10 000 and is frequently used in various GIS and CAD systems for subsurface, analysis, management and planning activities. Definition of railway section: Smallest functionally independent piece of railway track with uniform, homogeneous characteristics and relationships that is distinguished within a railway network. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "TOP10NL Railway section (lines)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include TOPkaarten, Topografische kaart, Stafkaart, Gebiedsinformatie, Plaatsbeschrijving, Geografisch. The listing shows 2026-04-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
